name: Pashupati Cotspin Limited
summary: Pashupati Cotspin Limited engages in the ginning, manufacture, processes, and sale of cotton yarns in India. It offers cotton bales, cakes, and seed; eli twist lycra cotton yarn, and wash oil. The company also offers BCI, organic, and other types of cotton yarns. Pashupati Cotspin Limited was founded in 1997 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
